name: insrc-vscode
description: insrc for VS Code — local-first, Ollama-backed code-knowledge and the tracked workflow, wired into your AI assistant.

insrc.chat.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the in-editor insrc ctrl (sidebar Activity Bar view) over your own claude/codex CLI. On by default. For insrc connections, [Manage Connections](command:insrc.openDataSources) opens the Saved and Temporary connection manager. Connection configuration and credentials are managed there.

enumDescriptions: Show edit diffs inside the terminal chat panel
Show edit diffs in a native VS Code editor diff
insrc.chat.diffView.markdownDescription: Where insrc ctrl renders assistant code-edit diffs: inside the terminal chat panel, or in a native VS Code editor diff.

insrc.chat.lockGroup.markdownDescription: Lock the insrc ctrl's editor group so files opened from the Explorer open in another group instead of as tabs over the chat. The group is locked the first time the chat is focused, and again after each window reload. Turn off to let tabs stack on the chat.

insrc.chat.turnLockTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long (in milliseconds) a new chat message waits for the session's previous CLI process to exit before that process is stopped. Only one CLI process works on a chat session at a time, in any window. Default 600000 (10 minutes).

insrc.daemon.threads.enabled.markdownDescription: serve admin and indexing work on their own worker threads (Epic 86197ac6); false runs the daemon on one thread

insrc.daemon.maintenance.idleMs.markdownDescription: ms with no non-admin request and both indexing lanes idle before idle maintenance (graph compaction) is considered

insrc.daemon.maintenance.minReclaimableP.markdownDescription: idle maintenance compacts only when at least this % of the graph file is reclaimable

insrc.daemon.maintenance.minReclaimableM.markdownDescription: idle maintenance compacts only when at least this many MiB of the graph file are reclaimable

insrc.daemon.maintenance.pauseLimitMs.markdownDescription: ms maintenance waits for running requests to finish before it gives up for this time

insrc.daemon.threads.sessionIdleMs.markdownDescription: ms a client session's worker thread may sit idle before it is released (Epic 86197ac6 s3); its step state outlives the release

insrc.classifier.confirmIntent.markdownDescription: prompt to confirm the classified intent each turn

insrc.codeReview.enforce.markdownDescription: enforce a blocking code-review verdict at Story completion (off ⇒ advisory)

insrc.codeReview.freshnessTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: max ms the code-review freshness gate block-and-polls for a fresh index before re-prompting

insrc.codeReview.daemonReviewCeilingMs.markdownDescription: max ms insrc_code_review_step waits in total for a daemon code review, progress or not

insrc.codeReview.daemonReviewIdleMs.markdownDescription: max ms a daemon code review may go without owner progress; independent of the chunk-derived total budget (legacy streams clamp to their ceiling)

insrc.designReview.premises.issue.markdownDescription: most premises a design review examines when the design answers an ISSUE

insrc.designReview.premises.spec.markdownDescription: most premises a design review examines when the design answers a SPEC

insrc.designReview.timeLimitMs.issue.markdownDescription: time limit (ms) for the whole review of a design that answers an ISSUE; capped at 30 minutes

insrc.designReview.timeLimitMs.feature.markdownDescription: time limit (ms) for the whole review of a standalone feature design; capped at 30 minutes

insrc.designReview.timeLimitMs.epic.markdownDescription: time limit (ms) for the whole review of a design under an Epic; capped at 30 minutes

insrc.review.chunkTokens.markdownDescription: most tokens one review call carries, counted at 3 characters per token (128000 = 384,000 characters), the same for every provider; larger reviews are divided into coherent chunks

insrc.analyzer.useLocal.markdownDescription: force code/data analyzers to local Ollama instead of cloud

insrc.analyzer.dataSourceListingTimeoutM.markdownDescription: max ms one live data source is given to be reached and listed when a request is measured; a source that does not answer is reported as a size that could not be determined

insrc.models.tiers.core.runner.markdownDescription:
[Open the grouped Model Tiers editor →](command:insrc.status.modelTiers)

The core tier's model family (runner). Valid values come from the daemon's model definitions; leave empty for the default. A model the family does not list is checked and approved with `insrc: Set model tier`; a family whose CLI runs on a host accepts only its listed models.

insrc.models.shaper.maxToolTurns.markdownDescription: max tool-loop turns for the shaper

insrc.models.local.host.markdownDescription: Ollama host for the embedder/local provider

insrc.models.local.embeddingModel.markdownDescription: embedder model id ('nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5' for ONNX) — read by the embedder

insrc.models.local.embeddingDim.markdownDescription: embedder dimensions (768 for ONNX) — read by the embedder

insrc.models.local.coreModel.markdownDescription: local core / summariser model id used by the indexer embedder

insrc.models.local.embeddingKeepAlive.markdownDescription: Ollama keep_alive for the embedder model ('24h' / '-1' forever / '0' eager-unload) — keeps the hot-path embed model resident during index bursts
